source_data_and_hypotheses.standing_construction: S3.SS1 fixes kappa >= 4, 3 <= n <= d, k=floor(d/n), O_j in O(n), and r=d-kn >=0. Source identities are pointwise; n=2T+1 is downstream choice, not an extra one-query hypothesis.
source_data_and_hypotheses.orthogonality: O(n) is the actual real matrix group O^transpose O=I. Matrix symmetry of A_O follows from E4, and regularity is derived in B.3, not a free oracle correctness or gradient premise.
source_data_and_hypotheses.precision_and_potential: S2 uses actual symmetric real precision matrices I<=A<=kappa I and f_A(x)=(1/2)x^transpose A x. The first-order oracle is exact and returns that potential and its ordinary Euclidean gradient.
source_data_and_hypotheses.primitive_semantics: Two flags must mean the actual matrix actions O_j v and O_j^transpose v. Flag labels alone cannot certify their relation.
source_data_and_hypotheses.coordinates: Source x is k consecutive R^n blocks followed by a residual R^r identity block. Any Lean product/finite-index encoding must state its bijection to R^(kn+r) and preserve the real Euclidean inner product.
source_data_and_hypotheses.zero_residual: When kn=d, the residual identity block is omitted. A Fin 0 / zero-dimensional Euclidean factor is acceptable only if all outputs still elaborate and agree with omission.

expected_definition_lets: A_O from exact E4 coefficients (kappa+1)/2 and (kappa-1)/4
A_vectorO from actual block diagonal E5 with residual identity
primitive oracle from actual O/O^transpose actions
gradient through actual differential/Riesz semantics rather than stipulated Ax
rejected_extra_public_premises: matrix-vector response supplied as an assumption
gradient equals A*x supplied as an assumption
potential equals one-half inner supplied as an assumption
symmetry/precision/derivative facts merely assumed when source derives them from construction
compiled producer lemma used to legalize extra binder

graph_expectations.coverage: All three selected formula obligations and their actual definition/coordinate leaves must feed the public root. Standalone nodes or duplicate labels are not coverage.
graph_expectations.ancestry: Trace actual potential/gradient to S2 quadratic definition plus exact precision and symmetry; trace block response to E4 plus both primitive meanings; trace aggregate gradient to E5 with residual identity.
graph_expectations.and_or: Conjunctive three-formula root must have all three parents. Alternative proof branches may be OR only when each independently establishes the same obligation under the same sealed binders.
graph_expectations.closure: Unresolved source gaps, false translation equalities, hidden semantic substitutes or extra-premise leaves must remain explicit; graph lint/imports do not certify them.

explicit_scope_exclusions: T first-order queries simulated by at most 2T primitives per block
source_model: Exact finite-dimensional real arithmetic. No floating-point tolerance, numerical-gradient surrogate, stochastic estimator or approximation.
